## Summary

Provide a one or two sentence overview of the feature you are requesting.

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who would benefit from it, and what is the current pain point or limitation?

## Proposed Solution / Fix

Describe the behavior, user experience, or implementation you would like. Be as specific as possible.

## Scope (if any)

Does this change affect a specific part of the codebase only? Is it a small addition, a new module, or a larger architectural change? Note any known boundaries or constraints.

## Affected Files / Areas to Change

List the files, modules, or components that are likely to be involved. Leave blank if you are unsure.

```
e.g.
src/tools/myTool.ts       — new tool module
src/tools/index.ts        — register the new tool
test/tool-schemas.test.ts — add schema test
```

## Acceptance Criteria

Define what "done" looks like. Each item should be verifiable.

- [ ] 
- [ ] 
- [ ] 

## Labels

Add any relevant labels for this issue. Common labels used in this project:

- `enhancement` — new feature or improvement
- `bug` — something is broken
- `documentation` — docs-only change
- `good first issue` — suitable for first-time contributors
- `help wanted` — maintainer is looking for a contributor
- `question` — needs clarification before work can begin
- `infra` — build, CI, or tooling change

## Tests

Describe what tests should be added or updated to cover this feature. Check off each item once done.

- [ ] Unit test for the new logic / module
- [ ] Schema validation test (if a new tool is added)
- [ ] Edge-case test for invalid or boundary inputs
- [ ] Integration test covering the full flow (if applicable)
- [ ] Existing tests still pass (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript check passes (`pnpm typecheck`)

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you considered and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional Context

Add examples, mockups, related issues, or implementation notes if useful.
